title: FourLeafClover
description: Lucky four-leaf clover: eat for saturation or shift+right-click to get a random vanilla item.
body:
Four Leaf Clover

A rare lucky clover that can be eaten for saturation or shift-right-clicked to receive a random vanilla item.

How to obtain
- Breaking grass / ferns: 10% drop chance (similar to wheat seeds but rarer).
- Crafting: Fill the entire 3x3 crafting grid with 9 wheat seeds to craft one clover.

How to use
- Right-click: Eat the clover to restore 1 hunger and gain 5 seconds of Saturation.
- Shift + right-click (air or block): Consume one clover to receive a random vanilla item.

What can you get?
- The clover picks randomly from all vanilla items (including rare ones like diamonds, netherite, elytra, etc.).
- Extremely rare items (dragon egg, nether star, ancient debris...) have their chances significantly reduced to keep gameplay balanced.
- Some useless or debug items (barriers, command blocks, spawn eggs, structure blocks, sculk family...) are completely blocked.

Features
- Only grants one item per use (stack size is always 1).
- Works on both air and blocks when sneaking, ensuring compatibility with other mods.
- Client and server friendly - works perfectly in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Modpack & technical info
- Minecraft: 1.19.2
- Loader: Forge
- Environment: Both (client + server)
- No dependencies.
- Feel free to include in modpacks!
